subject: Re: Headroom & commit rebalancing for renewal
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Hi Karthik,

We're starting to prep for our upcoming renewal and wanted to check in on options for shifting commit and adding short-term headroom. Q1 usage shot up due to a new feature and we expect similar traffic for the next 2-3 months. Can Redwood accommodate a temporary 30% headroom with an option to revert after 90 days? Also want a sense for how a 6-month vs 12-month term affects pricing per token and any credits for overage protection.

Attaching the Q1 export for reference.

Thanks,
Anna Liu
Director of ML Platform
Vectra Labs
[Attachment: vectra_usage_q1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Anna — thanks for the usage file, that helps. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary headroom and offer two commit paths that are commonly used.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30min sync this week to align on expected token trajectory (I can bring Ben for the ops/billing breakdown).
- I’ll draft a short-term amendment for a 90-day headroom window and pricing side-by-side for 6- vs 12-month commits.

High-level on pricing so you have context before the call:
- 6-month commit: more flexible, slightly higher per-token rate (~6-8% premium vs 12-month).
- 12-month commit: best rate and includes a small overage protection credit if you stay within a 10% variance.

I’ll loop Legal after we align on numbers. Are you available Wed 19th 10–11am PT or Thu 20th 2–3pm PT?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[redwood.ai]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Thanks for pulling this together. A few operational notes I’ll bring to the sync:

- Recommended headroom model:
  * Tiered burst: +30% guaranteed headroom for 90 days with auto-throttle to prevent runaway spend.
  * Rolling KV caching enabled for your high-repeat prompts (we see ~18% token saving on similar workload).

- Economics (ballpark for planning):
  * Base: $0.0033 / 1k tokens (current committed rate)
  * 6-month commit: $0.00354 / 1k tokens (~7% premium)
  * 12-month commit: $0.00306 / 1k tokens (~7% discount vs 6-month)
  * Temporary headroom fee: additional flat surcharge of 10% on tokens consumed above commit during the 90d window (capped).

I attached a short ops-level proposal that maps capacity and failover behavior for burst traffic.

[Attachment: headroom_proposal.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Pritchard <tom+procurement@vectralabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Appreciate the breakdown. A couple clarifying Qs before we lock a call:

1) If we take the 90-day headroom and then fully revert, will there be any long-term billing adjustments or is it purely one-off for that window?
2) Can Redwood provide a 6-month amendment instead of a 12-month if we want to avoid a full-year auto-renew?

Also, legal will want to see a draft amendment that explicitly calls out the headroom cap, surge protection, and data handling during the burst. Can you share a redline-ready doc?

—Tom
Sr. Procurement Manager, Vectra Labs

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Tom Pritchard <tom+procurement@vectralabs.com>, Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Tom — good questions. Short answers:

- Headroom billing: one-off for the 90d window. Once the window closes and usage returns under the committed baseline, billing reverts to the committed rates. No retrospective upward adjustments beyond the capped surcharge.
- Term options: we can do a 6-month amendment with the 6-month per-token rate outlined by Ben; we’ll include an explicit opt-in for auto-renew.

Attached are two items for your review:
- Commit amendment draft (6-month and 12-month options included).
- Q1 detailed usage export with per-route token breakdown.

Key ROI recap for your execs (two slides worth):
- Current incremental value: new feature drove +28% model queries but improved conversion by ~3.4 points (estimated $85k incremental revenue/mo).
- Cost delta analysis: with caching and short quantization on non-critical routes we estimate net token cost increase limited to +9% vs observed surge without controls.
- Recommendation: 6-month commit + 90-day headroom to preserve flexibility; convert to 12-month if post-campaign average stays above baseline for two consecutive months.

Links: HubSpot deal and shared drive with the amendment and SOW: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/VL-2027-0819 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-vectra-renewal

[Attachment: commit_amendment_draft.pdf (pdf, 64KB)]
[Attachment: usage_report_2027Q1.xlsx (xlsx, 74KB)]

Next steps:
- Please confirm preferred term (6m or 12m) and we’ll route a redline to your Legal for quick turn.
- If you want, we can lock the headroom effective immediately after signature and deploy the burst throttles.

—Karthik

From: Anna Liu <anna@vectralabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Pritchard <tom+procurement@vectralabs.com>, legal@vectralabs.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + headroom needs

Thanks — after reviewing internally, we’d like to proceed with the 6-month amendment plus the 90-day headroom. Please send the redline to our legal (legal@vectralabs.com) and we’ll aim to turn it in 72 hours. If possible, lock the headroom start on signature and confirm the throttle settings you plan to use so our SREs can mirror.

We’ll also request a short exec note summarizing the ROI bullet points you included for procurement.

Best,
Anna Liu
Director of ML Platform, Vectra Labs
